function acme_get_posts_html( $author_id ) {
	global $wpdb;
	$args      = [
		'author' => $author_id,
		'limit'  => 5,
		'extra'  => [ 'a', 'b' ],
	];
	$cache_key = 'acme_posts_' . absint( $author_id );
	$rows      = wp_cache_get( $cache_key, 'acme' );
	if ( false === $rows ) {
		$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT ID, post_title FROM {$wpdb->posts} WHERE post_author = %d LIMIT 5", $author_id ) );
		wp_cache_set( $cache_key, $rows, 'acme', 300 );
	}
	$title = isset( $_GET['title'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['title'] ) ) : '';
	foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
		echo '<li>' . esc_html( $row->post_title ) . '</li>';
	}
	echo esc_html( $title );
	return $args;
}
